## Projects

### Happening

- Shelf: Automation
- Status: Private
- Problem: Venue event listings are inconsistent and brittle
- Outcome: Turns venue pages into data
- Proof: 103+ source configs and 167 reliability tests
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=happening
- Stack: Python, Playwright, SQLite, Pydantic, GitHub Actions
